interactives.label: Garden well
interactives.text: Cold water from the garden well.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: The sour ground
interactives.text: The fourth well hummed and was filled. What is made under the hall is made on sweet ground, and counts double.

interactives.label: Training post
interactives.text: The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Reading
interactives.text: The caravanserai's under-room. Books read three times as fast off the road.

interactives.label: The hum
interactives.text: The well hummed, the crates hum, and the foals will not stand. The salt reader says it is the same hum.

interactives.label: The frontier
interactives.text: The east gate leads nowhere. The roads out are west, north and south.

interactives.label: Warm spring
interactives.text: The spring is warm and mineral; it restores you.

interactives.label: Butts
interactives.text: The butts list your recent combat results.

interactives.label: The hum
interactives.text: The fourth well hummed because it was dug into something that answers.

interactives.label: The foals
interactives.text: Foals born the season the well hummed would not stand. The herd-mother moved the herd; the hum did not follow.

interactives.label: The crates
interactives.text: Shard crates hum on the road south and stop at the border. The shard-hauler has stopped asking why.

interactives.label: The Barrow Reliquary
interactives.text: Under the barrow field, opened with bones as the Orun open a barrow.

interactives.label: Ward post
interactives.text: Nothing casts within these stones. The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Cistern
interactives.text: Rainwater from the cistern.

interactives.label: Breath
interactives.text: Rest here and the breath comes back twice as fast.

interactives.label: Water
interactives.text: A desert station and a well restore food; each can be used again after five minutes.

sections.name: The Seed Hollow
sections.label: A sink in the sand that never fills.
sections.note: A sink in the grass where the seed-heads fall and nobody follows them.

sections.name: The Well Garden
sections.label: A dry well. Handholds have been cut into its shaft.
sections.note: A garden under the dry well where the herd-mothers grow what the horses do not eat.

sections.name: The Mill Cache
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: The miller's cellar: a chest, a bench and grain not on the tally.

sections.name: The Hall Vault
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Under the hall, the khan's strongroom.

sections.name: The Fox Pit
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: An outpost cellar where the riders pen foxes for the young to learn on.

sections.name: The Caravanserai School
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: Where the caravan masters teach their drovers the roads.

sections.name: The Hidden Spring
sections.label: A sink in the sand that never fills.
sections.note: A warm spring under the south road; the only sweet water the well-digger will vouch for.

sections.name: The Outpost Butts
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: A gallery under the west outpost with dunrunners at the far end.

sections.name: The Barrow Reliquary
sections.label: A shrine slab with fresh scratches where it has been slid aside.
sections.note: Under the barrow field, opened with bones as the Orun open a barrow.

sections.name: The Standing Stone Well
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: Inside the stones nothing casts; the horses penned below are honest work.

sections.name: The Banner Focus
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Under the banner shrines the ether pools; spells cost half.

sections.name: The Steppe Waystone
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: Three stones by the east caravanserai. An iron rune wakes them.

sections.name: The Dune Eyrie
sections.label: A cairn built over nothing, or over something.
sections.note: A pocket under the desert road's first station.

secrets.note: Each section is one secret. The client shows a player only the section they stand in; the server places the arrival, the areas, the spawns and the harvest nodes from this block.

provenance.geometry: authored with the secret rooms kit over the shared toolkit

notes: 13 secrets of Sunmane Steppe Secrets on one map with void between them; which one a player gets is which feature of the ground above they used.
